what: a bearded devil: a lean, wiry, hard-muscled devil foot-soldier standing upright on two legs, with dull maroon scaly skin, long pointed ears, a bald head with two short black horns, small yellow eyes, a snarling mouth of fangs, a long thin tail and clawed feet. From his chin and jaw hangs a great beard that is not hair: a thick bunch of a dozen long, fat, wriggling black tendrils like snakes or thick ropes, hanging down to his belly with their tips curling outward. He has no wings. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dull maroon-red scaly skin, a beard of thick glossy black tendrils, black horns and claws, yellow eyes, a plain dark leather soldier's kilt with iron studs, a glaive with a dark wooden pole and a grey steel saw-toothed blade.
wears: He wears only a plain foot-soldier's kilt of dark leather strips with iron studs and a wide leather belt, and plain iron bands on his wrists. He has no breastplate, no helmet and no cape.
holds: He holds exactly one glaive in both hands: a thick dark wooden pole taller than he is, topped with one big broad curved grey steel blade like a huge kitchen knife, its cutting edge cut into large saw teeth. Both hands grip the pole and he holds nothing else.
pose: He advances to the left on two legs in a drilled soldier's stance, front knee bent, both hands on the pole thrusting the glaive forward and upward so the big saw-toothed blade is high and clear to the left of his head, his tendril beard swinging forward, mouth snarling.
must_show: maroon-skinned devil with small horns, pointed ears and a tail, no wings
a beard of thick black snake-like tendrils, readable in the small sprite
one glaive (long pole, big saw-toothed blade) in both hands
plain studded kilt, no body armour
a drilled foot-soldier

what: a barbed devil: a tall, lean, hunched devil sentry standing upright on two legs, bristling all over like a porcupine: long sharp ivory spines as long as daggers stick out from the top of its head, its neck, its shoulders, its whole back, the backs of its arms and legs, and all along its long thick tail, which ends in one great spike. It has a narrow reptile-like face with a jutting jaw of fangs, glowing yellow eyes, long arms and big hands with long hooked claws. It has no wings and no beard.
colours: burnt-orange scaly hide with a paler yellow-tan chest and belly, long ivory spines with dark brown tips, yellow eyes, black claws, small orange and yellow flames.
wears: It wears nothing at all except one plain iron sentry's collar round its neck; its spines are its only armour.
holds: Its clawed hands are empty and it holds no weapon. One small ball of orange and yellow flame burns in each open palm, touching the hand.
pose: It crouches forward to the left on two legs with its knees bent and its back hunched so the spines stand up, both clawed hands held out to the sides at waist height with the palms up and a small flame in each, its long spiked tail curled up high behind it over its back, jaws open hissing.
must_show: a devil covered in long ivory spines on head, back, arms and tail
burnt-orange hide
a small flame in each empty clawed palm
long tail ending in a spike, raised
no weapon, no wings, no beard

what: a chain devil spawn: a tall lean man-shaped devil jailer standing upright on two legs, whose whole body is hidden under heavy iron chain. Thick dark grey iron chain is wound round and round it in tight level coils, like rope coiled round a post: round its head, its chest, its waist, each arm and each leg, so that it looks like a statue made of coiled chain. The links are big chunky ovals of dark grey metal, each as large as a hand, and every link is plainly a chain link. No skin, no flesh and no muscle shows anywhere. Its head is a round ball of wound chain with no face, only two small glowing orange eyes in a dark gap. It has no wings, no horns and no tail. It has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs.
colours: dark gunmetal-grey iron chain on every part of the body and head, black shadow between the links, a few small spots of orange-brown rust, two small glowing orange eyes, two great hooks of bright bare polished steel, pale silver-white.
wears: It wears nothing but the chains that wrap its whole body.
holds: It holds no weapon and no whip. From each of its two wrists hangs exactly one short length of the same thick chunky grey chain, only four big links long, and each ends in one enormous hook like a butcher's meat hook: a thick bar of bright bare polished steel, pale silver-white, bent into the shape of the letter J, as big as its own head and as thick as its wrist, with a sharp upturned point. The right hook is swung up beside its head at the upper left, clear of the body against the backdrop; the left hook hangs beside its left knee, held out away from the leg. Both chains stay joined to its arms.
pose: It lurches to the left on two legs with one foot forward, its right arm flung up and forward so that its short chain and great pale steel hook swing up at the upper left, clear of its head, its left arm held out low and away from its side with the other great pale hook hanging from the wrist by its knee, body leaning into the throw.
must_show: a man-shaped figure made of coiled grey iron chain from head to foot: big chain links readable, no flesh
two glowing orange eyes in the wrapped head
two enormous pale steel J-shaped hooks on short chains from the wrists, each as big as its head, plain in the small sprite
dark grey iron colour, not red
no wings, no horns, no spines
must_not_show: black hooks lost against the body

what: a dire lion: a real Ice Age cave lion, a real animal on four legs, which looks like an enormous, tall, long-legged, heavily muscled lioness: it has no mane at all. Its head and neck are covered in the same short smooth pale fur as its body, with a sleek round skull, small round ears, a broad muzzle, a heavy jaw with very long yellowed fangs, thick forelegs with huge paws and long claws, and a long tail with a small dark tuft.
colours: pale sandy-cream short fur over the whole body, head and neck, with a paler cream belly and throat, faint grey-brown stripes on the legs only, amber eyes, a pink-brown nose, yellowed fangs, a small dark brown tail tuft.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it pounces to the left in mid-leap, hind legs stretched out behind and pushing off, both front legs reaching forward with the paws spread and claws out, jaws wide open roaring.
must_show: a real lion on four legs, seen from the side
no mane: a sleek short-furred head and neck like a lioness
pale sandy coat, huge heavy build
pouncing with claws out and jaws open
long fangs
must_not_show: sabre teeth hanging below the chin
dark brown hair on the neck

what: a dire bear: a real bear of monstrous size, an old scarred giant grizzly, a real animal, reared up on its hind legs the way a real bear stands to fight. It has a real bear's body: a huge barrel chest and belly covered in thick shaggy fur, short thick bowed hind legs with flat bear feet, heavy furry forelegs with big paws and very long curved claws, a great hump of fur behind the neck, a big wide head with small round ears, a long muzzle and yellowed fangs. One pale scar runs across its muzzle.
colours: shaggy black-brown fur over the whole body with grizzled silver-grey tips on the hump, shoulders and back, a lighter brown muzzle, a black nose, small dark eyes, yellowed fangs, long ivory claws.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side and turned a little to the viewer, it stands reared up on its two hind legs facing left, its body upright and leaning forward, its right front paw raised high above its head with the claws spread ready to swipe down, its left front paw held out ahead, head tipped forward, jaws wide open roaring.
must_show: a real bear reared up on its hind legs, furry all over
black-brown fur with grizzled silver shoulders
one forepaw raised high with long claws
jaws open with fangs
a real animal's bear body, not a man's
